nom: Peter Thomas Roth Instant FIRMx Glow-Filter Priming Serum

avis.titre: Tried the sample and had to purchase
avis.texte: I received a sample of this from Ulta and had to purchase the full size because I like it so much! This is absolutely perfect for the Summer. Sheer enough for some color and glow! Thank you!

avis.titre: This is nothing like Roths Skin to Die For.
avis.texte: I've been using Peter Thomas Roth's Skin to Die for which is fabulous. I had stocked up on it, but I am running out of it. It seems he is no longer making this great product which smooths your skin and makes it look younger. The Instant FIRMx Glow-Filter Priming is greasy, it leaves blobs of white on the surface of your skin. It does nothing to improve the look of your skin. People who give this product good reviews must not be looking at it near daylight. It's embarrassing. It does nothing for my skin but lay on the surface. Peter Thomas Roth - bring back Skin to Die For, please!
This product has the tendency to pill up when foundation is applied over it. Not a good feeling.

I'm almost 56. I've used several different brand over the years. This is absolutely THE best for mature skin I've tried. I hope they never stop making it. I love it so much I'm going to try their other products.

avis.titre: Does not do as it is advertised
avis.texte: I bought this 2 months ago after seeing results from tik tok. I don't really see that it has done anything for me, and doesn't do the firming that the tik tok videos show. I did end up purchasing the instant firmx eye cream so maybe that will be better.
Does not work at all I tried the instant firmware temporary face tightened. And it did nothing . So disappointed, and for that amount of money you would expect a little difference, but none

avis.titre: I am so confused by the packaging.
avis.texte: Please tell me if I'm doing something wrong. The product is OK, but I'm just baffled by the packaging

avis.titre: Its easy to use and Id buy again!
avis.texte: Im not sure yet if I like the tinted glow over the clear yet. But its not too shiny so you can use it alone or under powder or liquid foundation. I love using it everyday.
Easy to apply and was able to wear foundation over top, great for discolorations.

I've been trying all three products for 2 months. There hasn't been any lifting of my skin. Temporary or other wise. Plus I had a hard time with my makeup staying on over it. Will not buy these products again.

I received the collagen bounce stick in bronze glow. I am obsessed! This product gives you a glowy summer bronze with a plumping effect. This bronzing stick gives you the best no makeup- makeup look. So worth the price and I recommend to everyone wanting to try something new! :)

I was looking for something that would help my face/skin tighten and highlight my good features. At 66, I really want to highlight, not to surgically enhance. V3 been using this serum for 2 weeks, and my husband noticed m cheekbones!!

avis.titre: New bee to Peter Thomas Roth line!
avis.texte: I'm a New bee to Peter Thomas Roth Product , started with their cucumber mask , that was a top notch!!. Another product is the instant firm glow filter primer , This is a game changer , nice hydration and skin looks bright and definitely adds the glow!!!!

I absolutely love this instant glow filter primer! It leaves my face with such a smooth base! I love how glowy and dewy it leaves my skin ! I highly recommend this serum if you want a beautiful base every time! Gifted by peterthomasroth

avis.titre: Makes my skin luminous and radiant!
avis.texte: I received this product for free from Skeepers and Peter Thomas Roth in exchange for my honest opinion. Wow, this serum is amazing! I love the instant results. Upon application, my skin was immediately more luminous. I love the glow that this leaves! After about a week of use, my skin started to appear a bit more firm and defined. I think overall, what I love most about this product, is that that I can wear it standalone. If I don't want to wear heavy makeup, this is perfect to add just a bit of blur to imperfections and overall radiance. I slap on some mascara and lip tint, then I am ready to go! When I want a bit more of a finished look, this also looks great under a foundation.

Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth. Obsessed with this amazing primer serum! My skin looks amazing with the glow it gives! It makes my makeup look flawless too! My pores disappear all while looking my best and radiant!! It's a must for my makeup routine!

There's nothing better than to use a proper skincare product while covering those dark spots and imperfections that we have and this is exactly what this does. No big scents, lightweight and my skin is not oily. Gifted by peterthomasroth

Me encanta se adapta muy bien a el color de tu piel, disminuye las imperfecciones así que hace que em maquillaje se vea ver bien hermoso!!! Se los recomiendo mucho está genial y cumple muy bien sus funciones gifted by peterthomasrottSi

I love the Instantfirmx Glow-Filter Priming Serum I was gifted by Peter Thomas Roth. It leaves my skin looking so Dewey and glowing. I haven't been using it long enough to see the firming, but I can wait to see the long term results.

This made my skin look SO glowly, it's not shiny where your face looks greasy but it looks shiny. It evens out you skin color very well. It also works has a great primer for makeup, would definitely recommend this product. Gifted by peterthomasroth

This product was gifted to me by peterthomasroth in exchange for an honest review. I recently tried the Peter Thomas Roth Instant FIRMx Glow Filter Primer, and it has quickly become one of my favorite skincare products. This primer is like a magic filter in a bottle, providing an instant glow and a smooth canvas for makeup application. From the first use, I noticed how it addressed my skin concerns. The primer instantly firmed and tightened my skin, giving it a youthful, lifted appearance. It also helped to blur my fine lines and pores, creating a flawless base for my foundation. The lightweight formula glides on effortlessly and doesn't feel heavy or greasy, which is a huge plus for my combination skin.

This was gifted by peterthomasroth but the amazing priming serum worked wonders! I love how glowly my skin looked while this was applied! It's great by itself OR you can use it under your make up! I'm also very happy with the packaging of this!

Complimentary from Peterthomasroth This product is an interesting one. The Peter Thomas Roth Instant Firmx Primer, has been in my skin care routine for the past two weeks. I am still wating to see some change with my fine lines, hopeful that after a month of use I will be able to see some progress

I tried it today and I absolutely love it. I used it under my matte foundation and right when I put my foundation on. I saw a natural glow from within, and that was because of the primer. It gives you such a nice healthy glow without looking greasy, which I love. Gifted by peterthomasroth

This Peter Thomas Roth primer is sooo good! It's glowy and hydrating while minimizing the appearance of pores beneath makeup. I haven't had any issues with sensitivity/break outs or pilling when using it!

It feels so smooth on the face and my makeup lasts all day. It erases all my wrinkles and it gives a matte glow. It also holds my makeup pretty well. And it makes me skin feel really nice. I was offered by peterthomasroth

gifted by peterthomasroth! i don't believe in "primers" but i do believe in using serums to prime your skin before makeup! i love how this one is glowy and gives me a great base to lay on all of my makeup products on top of it!

Loved this product so much! it blends with the skin so well. helped my make up stay on for hours without it getting cakey. has a very light smell to it but it's very appealing. overall, I would say it's a really good product. offered by peterthomasroth

Gifted by peterthomasroth I love this product so much. You can wear it under your makeup for a dewy glow, or just on its own as skin care! It goes on so smooth and gives a gorgeous summer glow. It's so lightweight and truly does instantly form your skin. I will most definitely be repurchasing!

avis.titre: Beautiful finish without being too glowy!
avis.texte: I was gifted by Peter Thomas Roth and I love a good firming primer that gives a nice subtle glow to wear alone or under my makeup. This new one from Peter Thomas Roth is giving amazing skin with this beautiful finish! I love that this is unscented and a little goes a long way. It looks great and isn't too glowy or shimmery. This isn't heavy and is super lightweight and does not pill with other products. Total favorite right now! Plus it is hydrating enough for my dry to normal skin.

Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth. This is the first time I am trying out a makeup primer from this brand and as someone that has oily combo skin it is super important for me to have an effective primer to hold on to my make up for the entire day. After a few uses, I must say I'm very impressed with it and will continue to use throughout the summer.

I have been loving this priming serum! I love how it goes on super light, but it keeps my make up in place all day. This is such an awesome brand and I'm so happy they're expanding on their product line. Gifted by peterthomasroth

avis.titre: This is a Miss for me a waste of money
avis.texte: Not a fan of this..it did nothing for my complexion nor make my foundation go on smoother did nothing...I love most of PTR products and was surprised I didnt like this I tryed multible times to contact customer service by email and phone and NEVER received a response which is sad because I buy several of their products that I love and would have liked to just exchange it for something I could use but this is a NO for me and a waste of money

I was gifted this Peter thomas roth instant Firmx firming serum complimentary from Skeepers and Peter thomas roth in exchange for my honest review. This product was a game changer! It looked too dark upon first glance but blends in perfectly and added a subtle glow . My complexion was even , Radiant and smooth . I highly recommend this and have made it permanent in my routine. Wear alone or with makeup.

I'm absolutely loving this primer! It glides on my face smoothly and instantly absorbs into my skin. My makeup applies easily on top of it and it blends well with my skin tone. It's not greasy at all, and makes my skin feel so soft. I love the healthy glow it gives me, and how it plumps and firms my skin. It makes my skin look even and beautiful. I will definitely be using up this whole tube, and buying more after. I received this product complimentary from Peter Thomas Roth.

avis.titre: Another Slay From Peter Thomas Roth! ✨
avis.texte: I always enjoy Peter Thomas Roth, because of their consistent wonderful quality. I received this Instant Firm Glow Filter Primer complimentary from Peter Thomas Roth. I was in need of a new primer and was stoked to receive this one! ✨ As expected, this primer exceeded my expectations! It's hydrating, illuminating, leaves my skin feeling soft, looking more lifted and provides a perfect canvas for my makeup. I have had no pilling, no caking and my skin looks radiant and blurred. I especially like that I can use this as a primer and even on no makeup days for nice glowy skin. ✨

The Instant Firmx Flow Filter Primer was gifted by peterthomasroth in exchange for my honest review. Peter Thomas Roth has always been a brand that's piqued my interest since a lot of their products seem to be on the higher end side and have a lot of buzz around them, so I was excited to try this primer. I thought it was okay. In terms of firming, I don't necessarily feel that it made my skin feel noticeably firmer. However, I do think it left me with a nice glow that works as a great base for additional makeup.

avis.titre: Great to add to your routine!
avis.texte: I used this primer during my makeup routine before going out one night and wow!!! My makeup applied well over the primer and my skin looked great! Some primers dry out my skin or give my skin a weird texture, but this one was true to its word. This product was gifted by PeterThomasRoth Clinical Skincare in exchange for my honest review!

The serum has a lightweight, silky texture that absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling soft and hydrated without any greasy residue. It creates a perfect base for makeup, helping it glide on smoothly and last longer. On days when I go makeup-free, it still gives my skin a beautiful, healthy glow. One of the things I appreciate most is how it evens out my skin tone and minimizes the appearance of pores. The subtle, luminous finish it provides is exactly what I was looking for. Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth

I've been using this product for a couple weeks and love how even my face looks. I really like the nice glow it leaves. It is so easy to apply and doesn't not leave my face looking greasy at all. Definitely a great product. Gifted by peterthomasroth

A very glowy primer works good with my dry skin it has a universal glow so it will work good with most skin tones. It helps smooths the skin and has great skin care infused. I like the packaging and the pump.

Complimentary from peterthomasroth . This glow filter primer is so beautiful! It gives a nice illuminating golden glow no glitter so it looks very natural. I'm hoping over time and continued use I see more of the firming benefits. It doesn't pill and I personally like to wear it alone. I

I've really loved using this as part of my daily routine, even if I'm not fully getting ready to go out I'll still apply this for the skin benefits. I love that it adds a glow but also some depth to my skin, it just makes me look awake and like I've got some sun. I notice my skin is much more hydrated and overall healthier looking since I've began using this. I did receive this complimentary from peterthomasroth for my honest opinion.

This primer exceeded my expectations! I love how glow it looks on my skin. I was a little scared when I first applied it as it comes out very peachy color, but it very much blends greatly into the skin. It leaves the skin perfectly prepped for make up on top. Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth

I received this product complimentary from Peter Thomas Roth in exchange for my honest review~ This multi-tasking primer creates the perfect base for a flawless makeup application! It minimizes the appearance of pores and fine lines, creating a smooth canvas for foundation. My makeup glides on effortlessly, and lasts all day without creasing or fading. The result is a filter-like finish that makes my complexion look youthful and refined. The satiny texture is so satisfying to apply! I would recommend this for all skintypes across the board.

I was gifted this product complimentary from Peter Thomas Roth in exchange for an honest review. I really like this product! It looks super nice under makeup. It gives me a really pretty glowy base that I really like.

I've been using the Peter Thomas Roth Instant FirmX Glow Filter Primer, and it's a game-changer for my makeup routine! It gives my skin a beautiful, radiant glow and smooths out any imperfections, creating the perfect canvas for my foundation. The primer feels lightweight and doesn't clog my pores. My makeup lasts longer and looks more flawless throughout the day. Gifted by peterthomasroth

I was gifted by Peter Thomas Roth the instantfirmx glow filter priming serum. Really like how this product has been making my skin glow but I wish they came out with a cooler tone one. It doesn't go with my skin tone but in general looks great!

I received Instant FIRMx Glow-Filter Priming Serum complimentary from Peter Thomas Roth. I use this on no makeup days and makeup days. This works great as a primer. I really value my skincare. So, love how this doesn't just prep my skin for makeup but also helps my skin. My skin always looks so radiant and glowing. The more I have been using this product, the more sculpting I can see. My skin feels firm, soft, and plump. I highly recommend!

This product was gifted by peterthomasroth. To test this primer out, I did half of my makeup with it and the other half without. In the light, the side with the primer was illuminated and made my face glow. Indoors though, I could not see a major difference with the side that had the primer on. I would recommend it if you are wanting a soft glow or are looking to use it without foundation.

This is my new favorite product!! I've always loved the Peter Thomas Roth primer but this having a bronzed glow just takes it to the next level for me! Makes you look bronzed and beautiful while making your makeup last all night! Gifted by peterthomasroth

GLOW-FILTER PRIMER is a true lifesaver for my skin. This primer goes on so smoothly and feels light as a feather, creating a perfect base for my makeup. It's been amazing for tackling my fine lines and dullness, giving my skin a noticeable lift and firm look almost right away. The glow it gives is just the right amount of radiance—subtle but stunning. In golden hour lighting, my skin looks even more amazing, with a natural, lit-from-within shine that makes me feel fresh and luminous all day. gifted by peterthomasroth

This is the first product from Peter Thomas Roth that I have tried, and I'm in heaven! The glow, the shine, the absolute beauty this shows is amazing! It feels so smooth going on it's like wearing a second skin. This was gifted by peterthomasroth for my honest review.

avis.titre: Must have for a glowing complexion
avis.texte: As a long-time user of various skincare and makeup products, I have finally found a gem in the Instant Firm Glow Filter Priming Serum gifted by peterthomasroth.This product has completely transformed my daily routine, and I couldn't be happier with the results. **Appearance and Texture**: The serum itself has a lightweight, non-greasy texture that glides effortlessly onto the skin. Unlike other primers or foundations, it doesn't feel heavy or cakey, and it leaves my skin feeling breathable and fresh. **Tint and Coverage**: One of the standout features of this priming serum is its subtle tint, which provides just enough coverage to even out my skin tone without masking my natural complexion. I often wear it alone without any additional base, and it gives me a flawless, natural look. The tint is perfect for those who prefer a more minimalist approach to makeup. **Pore-Friendly Formula**: Having struggled with products that clog my pores and lead to breakouts, I was delighted to find that this serum does the opposite. It smooths out my skin without sinking into pores or creating pimples. This is a huge plus for anyone with sensitive or acne-prone skin. **Glow and Finish**: The glow this serum provides is truly remarkable. It gives my skin a radiant, healthy appearance, making me look awake and refreshed, even on the most tiring days. The luminous finish is enough to give me a confident, awake look without the need for additional highlighters or illuminators. **Overall Performanc

I've seen SO many TikTok videos of Peter Thomas Roth products that have been AMAZING so I was so excited to try out this Peter Thomas Roth Instant Firm Glow Filter Priming Serum. But wow, what a letdown! This does NOT do what their "viral" products claim to do. This does not instantly FIRM at all! Nor does it blur my pores! All it does is leave a glowy ORANGE tint to my skin - which actually enhances the look of my pores. If you're looking for a primer to help blur your pores, this is NOT it. If you're looking for a primer to give your skin a heavy GLOW, then you may like this. Personally, I'm super disappointed. GiftedbyPeterThomasRoth

Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth in exchange for my honest feedback. I was hopeful that this would run a bit more neutral, but it is still too orange/red for my very cool olive, light-medium skin tone. However, the tint is quite sheer, and I can still get away with it if I want. The finish isn't greasy. I have pretty oily skin, and I felt that this did not make much of a difference in the finish of my skin. I was still glowy, but my skin did look less 'greasy' and more 'hydrated.' The finish felt nice on my skin and left a nice primed surface. This primer is like a very nice moisturizer type primer (rather than a sticky or silicone finish primer). I did not notice much blurring, but my skin did look more hydrated and less textured. I think someone with dry skin would appreciate the finish of this product more than I do, although I think even on dry skin the glow from the product would be quite subtle and natural looking. This is not going to look like you are putting highlighter on your face. There isn't really any glitter once you apply the product. In the tube, it looks shimmery, even glittery, but I don't see any of that once it's on my skin. Also, I don't detect any fragrance. It doesn't really smell like anything, maybe a little fresh and clean? I think this product would be most appreciated by someone with normal to dry skin and a neutral to warm undertone.

This product is not as the usual primer makeup lovers are use to use, this primer doesn't blur your skin but it does make your skin look so healthy and beautiful that is much more worth it! It gives skin some intrinsic glow that make it look amazing. Product feels light to the touch and whe applied it does absorb well into the skin, doesn't feel heavy or greasy. This is a nice primer for people that value skin quality in their makeup! This product is complimentary from Peter Thomas Roth but this doesn't affect in any way my honest review.

This primer has fine glitter pieces or pigment pieces that are golden in it. I like how this primer makes my skin glow and my skin looks hydrated. I love how this primer has skincare benefits and forms your face over time. gifted by peterthomasroth.

I was worried that this would be too dark for my light skin, but it blends in beautifully without making me look orange. It has a very slight tint, so this isn't going to provide much color or coverage, just a skin evening effect and a slight pearlescent shimmer. It feels cooling going on and doesn't irritate my eyes. Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth.

Yall I absolutely love this I've legit just been wearing this alone with some gloss in this Texas heat this is perfect and the consistency is everything 10/10 recommendations for all the brown girlies gifted by Peterhomastoth

This reminds me of another SPF primer I have that has a similar color/shimmer to it. The thing I like about this formula that really makes a difference to me is the skincare that is added in too! Not only does this give a nice, glowy base under makeup but it also works on your skin as you're wearing it. No other shimmer primer I've seen can claim that! Gifted by peterthomasroth

It was gifted by peterthomasroth. I like this glow-filter primer. I like my skin with a glowing finish so this product is perfect. I used to wear primer and highlit but now I only need this one. It does both.

I was offered by peterthomasrothe to try for my honest review. The product looks like a highlighter at first but once applied, it leaves a light glow that's not glittery or harsh. I put it over my normal skin care as a primer and it didn't pill, it just left my face soft. I like that it also has skin care in it and can be used a variety of ways.

The Instant FIRMx Glow-Filter Priming Serum is my new favorite. It gives you an instant beautiful glow. The texture is just right and provides a great moisturizing. It last the whole day without feeling oily or caky. Works great with foundation.Gifted by peterthomasroth

I received this product as a complimentary from Peter Thomas Roth. As someone who struggles with the texture of some lotions and serums, etc, this is pretty amazing. Love the lightweight feeling it provides. The shimmer is very nice and a little goes a long way so great bang for your buck. Have received many a compliment on this.

avis.titre: Amazing! Use with or without makeup!

I feel like it wasn't too oily either and it just made my skin feel amazing. It felt like my skin immediately calmed down and just became more beautiful than before! I definitely recommend getting this primer, even just as an everyday elevating serum if you don't wear makeup often! It truly gave me a glow that almost didn't need makeup at all! So thankful to be gifted by peterthomasroth!

I've been using this primer for a while now, and it's fantastic! It makes my skin look smooth and even, instantly blurring my pores and smoothing my cheeks. My fine lines, especially on my forehead, are much less noticeable. It effectively covers up blemishes and redness, giving my skin an even tone and texture. complimentary from peter thomas roth

Peter Thomas Roth is seriously taking skin care to the next level with their new innovations. I've seen their products go viral on TikTok, and I couldn't believe my eyes so I had to try it for myself. This primer instantly firms my skin and makes it look flawless. I don't have a ton of wrinkles to begin with, but I feel that it almost puts a filter on my skin. There is definitely a method to using this product, I highly suggest reading the instructions to ensure the product works to its fullest potential. I didn't have any problems with my make up sitting on top of this primer, and I felt that it wore very well and extended the wear of my make up. This primer offered by Peter Thomas Roth is truly amazing.

I was gifted by Thomas Roth. I love this brand so I'm excited. This glow finish primer works great. It gave my skin a beautiful glow and I didn't even have to put any makeup on over it. Looked good on its own.

Gifted by peterthomasroth in exchange for an honest review. The Peter Thomas Roth primer was a nice addition to my makeup collection. It added a subtle youthful glow and a touch of hydration giving my skin a refreshed look.

Very great product I did receive this product for an exchange of my review and I've been using it on a daily basis and I love the way it's bringing my look together. I do get ready faster and I really will need to purchase it on my own This was gifted by Peter Thomas Roth

I put this on before my moisturizer and find that it works well as a serum. It offers a glowy finish to my face and masks the pores around my nose so they're not as visible. My skin looks amazing without putting any makeup on and it feels hydrated. Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth

This primer gives us like low to the face while at the same time blurring my pores that I tend to have around my cheeks and nose area. I find that the face is not too sticky and works well under makeup. Complimentary from peterthomasroth

Super super blendable and pretty! The glow is insane!!! I cant wait to wear it even on my body in the day time. Wasn't chalky or even chunky glitter. So far no skin irritation. Although gifted by Peter thomas roth , it was a hit
